title: Not all from Israel are Israelites
english: For not all who are from Israel are Israelites, nor are all children because they are the seed of Abraham. “In Isaac shall be named for you the seed” (Genesis 21:12) — not the children of the flesh are these the children of God (Romans 9:6-8).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans 9:6-8, where Paul distinguishes physical descent from Abraham from the true children of the promise.

title: Mercy, not will or effort
english: It does not depend on the one who wills or the one who runs, but on God who has mercy (Romans 9:16). He has mercy on whom he wills, and he hardens whom he wills (Romans 9:18). Glory to God. Amen.
